title: Jonah and the Smile
author: Paloma Oyelaran
blurb: Mara Vasquez, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
